newsitem.title: INDIA: Bombay index posts fourth largest plunge ever.
newsitem.headline: Bombay index posts fourth largest plunge ever.

text.p: A nearly 300 point-or-eight percent fall in the Bombay Stock Exchange's (BSE) top 30-share index on Monday, after a political crisis swept through markets, was the BSE's fourth largest fall ever, Bombay bourse officials said.
Bombay's benchmark stocks index plummetted 299.63 points, or 8.2 percent, to close at a provisional 3363.90.
All three previous large single-day falls occurred in 1992 during a share scandal that rocked the country's stock markets.
The index fell 570.42 points on April 28. It dropped 333.60 points on May 12 and lost 327 points on May 6.
